Introduction

Hello, and welcome back.

Today we have a fun surprise.

It is about football and pop music.

Many fans did not expect this news.

So why are people excited?

And why are some fans a little shocked?

Let’s hear the story in easy English.

Practice

What game may have a music show at half-time?

The World Cup final may have a music show.

What is half-time?

It is the short break in the middle of the match.

Which stars are named in the reports?

Madonna, Shakira, and BTS are named.

Why are many fans excited?

They may get football and pop music in one event.

Is the music show final fact now?

No.

It is still a report, not final fact.

Summary

Nice work today.

This story had football, music, and surprise.

Do you want a music show at half-time?
